title: Cursors that explain the action
summary: pointer, grab, help, text, move and not-allowed: hover each tile to see what the cursor promises.
explanation: cursor changes the mouse pointer while it is over an element. It is a promise about what will happen: pointer (the hand) says click me, grab says you can drag, not-allowed says this is disabled.

Buttons do not get the hand by default in every browser, so many designs add cursor: pointer to them. Do not put it on things that are not clickable: a hand over plain text makes people click and get nothing.
Touch screens have no cursor, so it can never be the only clue. Pair it with a visible style, like the striped background on the disabled tile.
tryThis: Hover every tile in the preview.
Change .grab to cursor: grabbing, the closed hand shown while dragging.
